item.title: Preheating Your Oven Is More Important Than You Think
item.description: Putting food in before the oven reaches the right temperature can change how it cooks, bakes, and browns. Preheating is a step you don’t want to skip.

item.title: Never Waste the Last Bit of Soap Again
item.description: Press the leftover piece of your old soap bar onto a new one and let them stick together, so you can keep using every last bit instead of throwing it away.
